app.name: InvoiceFlow
app.tagline: Invoicing and payments for small teams
app.description: InvoiceFlow helps small businesses send invoices, collect payments and keep an eye on cash flow. This is a fictional sample app bundled with AppLens.

personas.label: Business owner
personas.description: Runs the business and needs invoices out the door fast.
goals: Send invoices in under a minute
See cash flow at a glance

personas.label: Accountant
personas.description: Keeps the books accurate at month end.

features.title: Invoice in seconds
features.description: Create a polished invoice from a template and send it straight away.

features.title: Automatic reminders
features.description: Polite nudges go out on a schedule until an invoice is paid.

features.title: Online payments
features.description: Clients pay by card or bank transfer from the invoice itself.

features.title: Payment reconciliation
features.description: Match incoming payments to open invoices in a few clicks.

features.title: Cash flow dashboard
features.description: See what is due, overdue and expected this month.

features.title: Client portal
features.description: Clients see every invoice and payment in one place.

features.title: Accounting exports
features.description: Hand your accountant a clean export every month.

scenarios.title: Send an invoice and get paid
scenarios.description: From a blank draft to money in the bank.

steps.narration: Create a new invoice as a draft.
A reminder goes out automatically before the due date.
The customer pays online and the invoice is marked as paid.
Check the reminder history and call the customer.
The payment arrives, so mark the invoice as paid.
Find a draft that is no longer needed.
Delete it to keep the list tidy.
